exposure_reconciliation: Clarification: The pilot processed 3,600 sampled sequences over 300 optimizer steps. Because sampling with replacement was used, exactly 3,070 unique records were seen (25.58% of the dataset), with 530 instances being repeated samples. In terms of active target tokens, the model processed 124,360 target tokens out of 414,814 in the corpus, representing an exact token-level exposure fraction of 29.98% (~0.30 equivalent epochs).
